verdict.rationale: The copy-install mode writes skills into your repo as ordinary files you own, and the docs say "Nothing updates behind your back", with updates pulled only when you run `npx skills update`. That lets a lead gate changes, effectively by vendoring them into the repo. However, the Claude Code plugin route, now described as the documented install path, is a managed, read-only, always-current bundle that updates when the author ships. Neither mode offers explicit version pins or a lockfile. Missing for 10: explicit version pinning or lockfile mechanism, update control for the plugin/marketplace install path, independent or hands-on corroboration.
